transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because this has been going on for months in my apartment building. The property manager, and some people there, have been using misdelivered mail, noises in the walls that happen at certain times, and little comments from neighbors to push me out.

They keep giving paperwork and explanations, but that doesn’t change the pattern I’m seeing. It’s gotten to the point where I felt I needed to talk to someone about it.
Do you believe for certain that the people in your building are intentionally trying to push you out?

Yes. I do believe it’s intentional. I know how that sounds, but this has been going on for months—the mail ending up wrong, the noises in the walls at certain times, the comments from people in the building. They can hand me paperwork or give explanations, but it doesn’t change the pattern I’m seeing. It feels like they’re trying to pressure me out.
Have you ever heard voices when no one was actually there?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices like someone talking when nobody’s there. That’s not really what’s been happening.
Have there been times lately when your mood felt unusually high, energized, or almost too good?
No, not really. I haven’t felt unusually high or overly energized. My mood has mostly just been… focused on what’s been happening, but not like “too good” or out of control.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day lately?
I’m not sure I’d say depressed most of the day nearly every day. I’ve been upset and worn down by all of this, but I don’t know if that’s the same as being depressed.
Do you believe anyone is using special devices, technology, or other unusual methods to control you or send messages to you?

I don’t know that it’s “special devices” exactly, but there’s definitely a method to it. For months, the property manager and certain people in the building have been using things like misdelivered mail, noises in the walls that happen at specific times, and little comments from neighbors to send a message and pressure me to leave the apartment. They can call it paperwork mistakes or coincidence, but the pattern is too clear to me.
Have there been times when you were having these experiences even though you were not depressed or unusually high in mood?

Yes. This has been going on for months, and it isn’t because I’m depressed or because my mood is high. Even on normal days, I can see the pattern — the misdelivered mail, the noises in the walls at certain times, the neighbors making little comments. It’s the property manager and certain people in the building trying to pressure me out of the apartment. Their explanations don’t really change what I’m seeing.
Have you been having trouble keeping up with your usual work, daily tasks, or relationships?

Yes, it has affected that. I’ve pulled back from several consulting jobs because I can’t really focus on them the way I used to. A lot of my week gets taken up following up with neighbors, offices, and building staff, trying to sort out what’s going on. So I’m not keeping up with my usual work or even my normal painting routine like I normally would.
Have you noticed your thoughts or speech becoming disorganized, like it’s hard to stay on track or make yourself understood?

No, I don’t think so. I can explain myself clearly enough. I might get worked up or go over the details because there’s a lot to keep straight, but I don’t feel like my thoughts are jumbled or that people can’t understand me.
Have you noticed yourself becoming much less emotionally expressive or less motivated than usual?
I don’t think so, no. I still react to things, and I still care about what I’m doing. I may be more preoccupied lately, but I wouldn’t say I’ve become flat or unmotivated in that way.
Do you feel that you deserve this treatment because you’ve done something wrong?

No. I don’t think I did anything to deserve it. That’s part of what bothers me. I’m here because for months the property manager and some people in the building have been using things like misdelivered mail, noises in the walls at certain times, and little comments from neighbors to pressure me out of my apartment. They keep giving explanations and paperwork, but it doesn’t change the pattern I can see.
Have you felt that other people can hear or know your thoughts, even when you have not said them out loud?

No, not like they can hear my thoughts exactly. It’s more that they seem to know how to get to me—through the misdelivered mail, the noises in the walls at certain times, and the comments from neighbors. That’s the pattern I’m talking about. They say it’s just paperwork or normal building issues, but I don’t buy that.
Do you believe anything impossible is happening to you, such as people changing your thoughts or controlling your mind?

No, I don’t think anyone is changing my thoughts or controlling my mind. It’s not that. What I’m saying is more practical: for months the property manager and certain people in the building have been using misdelivered mail, noises in the walls at certain times, and little comments from neighbors to push me out of my apartment. They can call it paperwork or coincidence, but the pattern is still there.
Aside from the noises in the walls, have you seen things that other people could not see?

No, I haven’t seen things that other people couldn’t see. At least, not that I’m aware of. The issue has been the noises and the other things happening around the building, not visions or anything like that.
During this period, have you had a stretch where you felt depressed nearly all day, almost every day, for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure I’d call it that. I’ve been upset and worn down by all of this, but depressed nearly all day every day for two weeks… I don’t think so, not in that clear-cut way.
Have you ever felt that outside forces were inserting thoughts into your mind?
No, I haven’t felt like thoughts were being put into my mind by some outside force. My thoughts feel like my own.
Have you ever felt that your actions or movements were being controlled by someone or something outside yourself?

No, not like someone is moving my body or controlling my actions. It’s more that the property manager and certain people in the building have been pressuring me—misdelivered mail, noises in the walls that happen at certain times, little comments from neighbors. They say it’s nothing, or show paperwork, but the pattern is there.
Do you believe anything impossible is happening around the situation in your building?

No, I wouldn’t say “impossible.” It’s not magic or anything like that. It’s people in the building—the property manager and some neighbors—using things like misdelivered mail, noises in the walls at certain times, and little comments to pressure me out. They can show me paperwork or give explanations, but the pattern is still there.
For how long have these experiences in your apartment building been going on?
It’s been about 11 months now. It started not long after I moved into that apartment.
Before this started, had you been diagnosed with any brain or neurological illness?
Not that I know of. I mean, I’ve never been told I had a brain illness or neurological condition before all this started.
